_comment: Hearthbound (End Remastered eye coverage): widens minecraft:has_structure/igloo, which gates endrem:cold_eye. Not wiped, just never widened: RU and BWG each put two or three biomes in, out of six and five snowy biomes respectively. Igloos are the only source of endrem:cold_eye (70% per chest, the richest eye chest in the game), so a snowy biome that cannot hold an igloo is a dead end. This brings the tag to full snowy-class parity and no further. replace:false merges on top of whatever the jars ended up with, and this datapack loads after mod jars, so it also lands on top of a mod's replace:true. Regenerate with .claude/tools/gen-endrem-eye-coverage.js; measure with .claude/tools/endrem-eye-audit.js.
